notes:
PlaneSite 1.6.7:
- Send to Pilot 2: each field in the Areas list has a new send button. It turns the field's outline into a DJI mapping mission (flight height, speed, overlaps, edge buffer and flight-line direction, with an estimate of lines, photos, flight time and batteries) and uploads it to the PlaneSite hub. The pilot then finds it in Pilot 2 under Flight Route, cloud library, and downloads it to open the boundary and flight lines.
- The first time, open Hub connection in that window and enter the hub's office password. It is kept in Windows Credential Manager, not in PlaneSite's files.
- Sending a field again with the same mission name replaces the copy on the hub. Every mission file is also saved in the project's exports\Pilot 2 folder.
